I submitted **index 12 (Sb fraction 0.411)** as the best composition. It had the highest measured EQE, 0.319%. All 5 EQE measurements are used; I used none of the 5 XRD measurements.

| Index | Sb fraction | EQE (%) |
|---|---|---|
| 6 | 0.242 | 0.083 |
| **12** | **0.411** | **0.319** |
| 14 | 0.485 | 0.313 |
| 20 | 0.675 | 0.0099 |
| 26 | 0.816 | 0.0061 |

- **Where the peak is:** EQE is highest across Sb fractions 0.41–0.49. Indices 12 and 14 are almost tied, so I can't say which of the two is really better from one reading each.
- **Sb-rich side:** EQE drops almost to zero at and above index 20. That sample sits near NiSb₂O₆ (Sb 0.667), one of the database's known Ni–Sb–O crystal structures. With no XRD taken, I haven't checked which phase any sample actually contains.
- **Ni-rich side:** EQE falls to 0.083% by index 6.
- **What I didn't measure:** the true best could still be at index 10 or 11 (Sb 0.35–0.38) or index 13 (Sb 0.448). I also have no measurements below Sb 0.24.
